scenes.heading: Loading Data into a Warehouse
scenes.narration: Before you can query data, you have to get it in efficiently, and warehouses offer both bulk and continuous loading paths.

scenes.heading: The typical load pipeline
scenes.narration: Most loads start by dropping files into cloud object storage like S3 or GCS. The warehouse points a stage at that location and runs a bulk COPY command to ingest the files. After loading you validate row counts and transform the raw data into clean models.

scenes.heading: Loading best practices
bullets: Split large files into many mid-sized chunks for parallel loading.
Prefer compressed columnar formats like Parquet when possible.
Use a staging table so bad rows never pollute production.
Load in bulk rather than row-by-row inserts, which are slow and costly.
scenes.narration: Splitting big files lets every compute thread load in parallel, so throughput scales up. Compressed formats and staging tables keep loads fast and safe from bad records. The cardinal rule is to load in batches, because single-row inserts waste both time and money.

scenes.heading: Batch loading vs continuous loading
scenes.narration: Batch loading with COPY runs on a schedule and is perfect for hourly or nightly feeds. Continuous services like Snowpipe ingest files the moment they land, giving near-real-time freshness. Choose batch for cost and simplicity, and continuous when minutes of latency matter.

scenes.heading: Bulk loading with COPY
scenes.code:
-- Create a stage pointing at cloud storage
CREATE STAGE sales_stage
  URL = 's3://my-bucket/sales/'
  FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' SKIP_HEADER = 1);

-- Bulk load the staged files into a table
COPY INTO sales
FROM @sales_stage
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' SKIP_HEADER = 1)
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE';
scenes.narration: First we define a stage that references the folder in cloud storage along with the file format. Then the COPY INTO command bulk loads every matching file into the sales table in parallel. The ON_ERROR clause tells the warehouse to skip malformed rows instead of failing the whole load.

scenes.text: Stage files in object storage, then bulk COPY in parallel, and reach for continuous loading only when you need fresh data fast.
scenes.narration: Stage your files and bulk load them with COPY for efficiency, and add continuous ingestion when low latency truly matters.
